entfernt.satz: *Certificate.* Exact Laplace algebra in rational arithmetic; the verifier returns $\lambda=288$ and $\lambda=100$ respectively [C-modular-R9a, C-modular-R9b]. *Status:* already known are the equations $\Delta X_w=\lambda_wE_w$ and the combinations $X_w$ at the weights $w=3,5,7,9$ (DGV eq. 3.33) [C-modular-R9a].
entfernt.grund: Zahl(en) [3.5, 7.9] stehen in keiner zitierten Claim

entfernt.satz: The criterion fails because the singular value $4.149\times10^{-9}$ lies below 1e-8, while $7.591\times10^{-44}$ is the null direction.
The column "null" counts the singular values below 1e-24, the column "large" those above 1e-8.
This is established at the odd weights up to $w=61$ (Theorem 1) [C-modular-R17a], and before that it was a conjecture read off from the weights 3 to 13 [C-fakt-konstanten].

At 8 points not used before (seed 9001, including $\tau$ near $\rho$ and $\tau_2$ up to 3), the weight-11 relative residual is at most $10^{-d}$ at every working precision $d$ at 8 of 8 points [C-fakt-haertung].

story.kernfrage: What are the exact constants in the identities X_w = f_w E(w) + g_w zeta(w) between the combination X_w of dihedral modular graph functions and the Eisenstein series E(w) at odd weight w, and can closed forms for them be proved?
story.kernaussage: For every odd weight 3 <= w <= 61, the D'Hoker-Green-Vanhove combination X_w of dihedral modular graph functions satisfies X_w = f_w E(w) + g_w zeta(w) exactly, with f_w = 3((w-1)/2)!/w and g_w = 6|B_{w-1}|/((w-1)/2)!.
story.titel: Closed forms for the constants in the odd-weight identities between dihedral modular graph functions
story.keywords: modular graph functions, Eisenstein series, Laplace equation, Bernoulli numbers, closed-string one-loop amplitude, Laurent polynomial
